:::{.callout-warning}
**Not yet shipped.** The Pack design is approved and the build tooling
lives in [`scripts/uiao-env-pack/`](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/tree/main/scripts/uiao-env-pack),
but no release has attached a `uiao-pwsh-pack-*.zip` artifact. This
page describes the intended contents, install flow, and provenance
shape. Download links and SHA256 values become authoritative the
first time the artifact is published — until then, treat this as a
forward-looking specification.
:::

The UIAO PowerShell Pack is a single downloadable zip that brings an
operator workstation from bare Windows to fully tooled for UIAO work
without requiring internet access at install time. One file contains
the PowerShell 7 runtime, a curated set of PowerShell modules, the
git and GitHub CLI clients, and an offline installer that runs them
silently and verifies SHA256 integrity before executing anything.

## Pack contents

| Component | Version | Uncompressed | Purpose |
|---|---|---:|---|
| PowerShell | 7.5.5 | 108 MB | Cross-platform runtime (Core edition) |
| PSScriptAnalyzer | 1.25.0 | 285 MB | Static analysis for PowerShell scripts |
| Selenium | 3.0.1 | 60 MB | Browser automation used by assessment scripts |
| Microsoft.Graph.Authentication | 2.37.0 | 39 MB | Graph API authentication for Entra operations |
| Az.Accounts | 5.4.0 | 29 MB | Azure authentication for Arc / Intune operations |
| Pester | 5.7.1 | 1.1 MB | PowerShell test framework |
| powershell-yaml | 0.4.12 | 1.3 MB | YAML parsing for canon files |
| Git for Windows | 2.47.0 | 66 MB | Source control client |
| GitHub CLI | 2.62.0 | 13 MB | GitHub API and release tooling |
| **Pack zip** | **0.1.0** | **245 MB compressed** | (~603 MB after install) |

Every downloaded artifact has its SHA256 recorded in the bundled
`manifest.json`. The offline installer verifies hashes before
running any installer or copying any module — a tampered or
truncated download is refused.

## Download

The Pack is not yet attached to a GitHub release. The authoritative
release page is
<https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/releases/latest>; once a
`uiao-pwsh-pack-<version>.zip` asset is published there, this section
will document the exact `gh release download` command, the
`Invoke-WebRequest` URL, and the Zip SHA256 for integrity
verification.

Until then, build the pack from source (see [Source](#source) below) —
the produced zip is bit-identical given the same manifest and the
same upstream artifact versions.

## Install

Once a release artifact exists, install proceeds as:

```powershell
Expand-Archive uiao-pwsh-pack-<version>.zip -DestinationPath C:\uiao-pack
& C:\uiao-pack\uiao-pwsh-pack-<version>\Install-UIAOPack.ps1
```

The installer runs four numbered steps and logs `OK` / `FAIL` / `SKIP` for each item:

1. **PowerShell 7 runtime** — silent MSI install to `C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\`
2. **Modules** — copy into the per-user module path `$env:USERPROFILE\Documents\PowerShell\Modules\`
3. **Tools** — silent install of git and GitHub CLI
4. **Verify** — confirm modules and tools are reachable

### Switches

| Switch | Effect |
|---|---|
| `-ModuleScope Machine` | Install modules system-wide under `$env:ProgramFiles\PowerShell\Modules\` instead of per-user. Requires elevation. |
| `-SkipRuntime` | Skip Step 01 when PowerShell 7 is already installed |
| `-SkipTools` | Skip Step 03 when git / gh are managed through a different channel |
| `-StrictInstall` | Abort on first failure instead of logging and continuing |

## Edition note

The pack installs PowerShell 7 (Core) and targets pwsh 7 module
paths (`Documents\PowerShell\Modules`). If your default terminal
still launches Windows PowerShell 5.1 (`powershell.exe`), the
bundled modules will not be visible — 5.1 has a separate module
path under `Documents\WindowsPowerShell\Modules`.

After installing the pack, switch your terminal default:

- **Windows Terminal** — Settings → Startup → Default profile → **PowerShell** (the 7.x profile with the black icon, not the blue **Windows PowerShell** profile)
- **VS Code** — set `"terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.windows": "PowerShell"` in user settings

Verify with `$PSVersionTable.PSVersion` in a fresh terminal — should report `7.5.x`, not `5.1.x`.

## Source

Build tooling, the manifest, and the offline installer source all
live in the UIAO repository under
[`scripts/uiao-env-pack/`](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/tree/main/scripts/uiao-env-pack).
A developer with PowerShell 7 and a network connection can
reproduce the pack from source:

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao.git
& .\uiao\scripts\uiao-env-pack\Build-UIAOPack.ps1
```

Produces `scripts\uiao-env-pack\build\uiao-pwsh-pack-<version>.zip`.
Bytes are bit-identical given the same manifest and the same upstream artifact versions.

## Provenance

| Pack version | Release tag | Build date | Zip SHA256 |
|---|---|---|---|
| (planned) | (pending first release) | — | (recorded at publish time) |

The SHA256 will be regenerated on every rebuild and updated here
each release. The bundled `manifest.json` inside the zip records
SHA256s for every component artifact (pwsh MSI, git installer, gh
MSI) so any single bit-flip is detected before execution.
